what: A: Create an invite (1 use, 1 day) — invite 2, to expire

actions.eval: (() => { const f = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-layer=door] input')].find(x => (x.closest('label')?.innerText ?? '').includes('Days valid')); f.focus(); f.select(); return f.value })()

(async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { const l = document.querySelector('[data-layer=door]'); const m = l && /unmapped:\/\/join\?i=[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+&k=[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+/.exec([...l.querySelectorAll('input, textarea')].map(x => x.value).join('\n')); if (m) { window.__invite = m[0]; return m[0].length; } await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return 'no link' })()
(() => { const l = document.querySelector('[data-layer=door]'); if (!l) return 'no door layer'; const t = l.innerText; const i = t.indexOf('Invites'); return t.slice(i, i + 900) })()
